Package com.egradx.notification.delivery

Record Class EgradxDeliveryView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.notification.delivery.EgradxDeliveryView
Record Components:
traceId - the trace of the request that sent the message, when the application has a tracer
requestId - that request's X-Request-ID — the id shown in its error messages and logs
public record EgradxDeliveryView(UUID id, UUID messageId, UUID organizationId, String channel, String notificationKey, String address, EgradxDeliveryStatus status, int attempts, Instant nextAttemptAt, String lastError, String providerMessageId, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt, Instant sentAt, String traceId, String requestId) extends Record
One row of the delivery log, as reported to callers and operators.
